### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **1** package(s): `@objectstack/rest`, touching **3** documentable anchor(s).

**20** hand-written doc(s) name something this change touched — list omitted above 15 rows. Re-derive on the tree named below: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 0c7e95aff5996de2313b4668760eafee2e50172d`.

⛔ **6** release-owned page(s) also affected — read-only, see AGENTS.md Documentation Guardrails.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- the SDK route bridge reached **61** of **219** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **158** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **158**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **103** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **19** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 0c7e95aff5996de2313b4668760eafee2e50172d` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `1fcb5ac76bad309a07e8870cdfa644134fe6b13e` — the merge of head `976da77fcf5aab9d9d09e3b7de57cecde4fc714d` into base `0c7e95aff5996de2313b4668760eafee2e50172d`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 1fcb5ac76bad309a07e8870cdfa644134fe6b13e && git checkout 1fcb5ac76bad309a07e8870cdfa644134fe6b13e
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 0c7e95aff5996de2313b4668760eafee2e50172d 976da77fcf5aab9d9d09e3b7de57cecde4fc714d && git checkout -B drift-repro 0c7e95aff5996de2313b4668760eafee2e50172d && git merge --no-ff 976da77fcf5aab9d9d09e3b7de57cecde4fc714d

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 0c7e95aff5996de2313b4668760eafee2e50172d
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 0c7e95aff5996de2313b4668760eafee2e50172d` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `976da77fcf5aab9d9d09e3b7de57cecde4fc714d`
Local-runs: none
Scope: packages/rest/src/approvals-routes.ts, packages/rest/src/rest-server-approvals-status-value.test.ts, packages/rest/src/rest-server-approvals-unknown-filter.test.ts + packages/spec/src/contracts/approval-service.ts, packages/plugins/plugin-approvals/src/sys-approval-request.object.ts, packages/plugins/plugin-approvals/src/approval-service.ts, packages/plugins/plugin-approvals/src/approval-vocabularies.test.ts, packages/rest/src/query-allowlist.ts, packages/rest/src/query-multiplicity.ts, packages/rest/src/rest-server.ts, packages/client/src/index.ts, ui/apps/console/src/pages/system/ApprovalsInboxPage.tsx, ui/apps/console/src/services/approvalsApi.ts, ui/apps/console/src/services/approvalRequestsDataSource.ts, ui/packages/app-shell/src/hooks/sharedUserFeeds.ts, ui/packages/data-objectstack/src/index.ts, content/docs/automation/approvals.mdx, docs/adr/0087-metadata-protocol-upgrade-contract.md

Inputs: card #29880 (body, triage 6600556144, claim 6657794401, dev report 6659778723), PR #30491 body, file list and the diff against `main` at the head (4 files, +294/-2; the merge-base is `f273c9fe` and none of the cited files moved on `main` since), and the check-runs on the head: 35 success, 13 skipped, none pending or failed, read twice (once before judging, once before posting). The changeset is read for ② only; the published spec and every cited file were read on `origin/main`, not reviewed.

### ① Derived judgments

- **Accept-set narrowing, `status` value on `GET {base}/approvals/requests` and its environment-scoped twin (one handler, `registerApprovalsEndpoints`, `isScoped` only moves the environment id).** A value outside `APPROVAL_STATUSES` answers 400 where it answered 200 `{"data":[]}`. **Right.** The spec on `main` never declared a free string: `IApprovalService.listRequests` takes `status?: ApprovalStatus | ApprovalStatus[]` (approval-service.ts contract L936) and `ApprovalStatus` is derived from `APPROVAL_STATUSES` (L57-67, six values with `cancelled`). The door now refuses what the contract's own type already refused at every typed consumer.
- **Single source of the allowed set (brief c).** `sys_approval_request.status` is `Field.select(APPROVAL_STATUSES.map(...))` (sys-approval-request.object.ts L320-327), and `approval-vocabularies.test.ts` L55 pins `optionValues(SysApprovalRequest, 'status')` equal to `[...APPROVAL_STATUSES]` on `main`. No drift is possible without that pin going red: no status the object accepts is refused by the route.
- **Refusal set is exactly unknown values plus the empty forms (brief a).** Read in the diff: `raw === undefined` leaves the filter unset; each comma entry is trimmed and must be in the set; one entry reaches the service as the string it always did; several as a deduplicated `ApprovalStatus[]`; `''` and an empty entry are unknown (the empty string is not in the set). Every one of the six declared values keeps its single-value answer (test §2 `it.each(APPROVAL_STATUSES)` asserts the argument the service received, not just 200). **Right.**
- **Empty `?status=` refused as part of the narrowing.** Before: the service's `else if (filter?.status)` (plugin approval-service.ts L9158) treats `''` as no filter, so `?status=` answered every status. Reading it as absent would have kept a silent widening; the same door already refuses `?limit=` / `?offset=` (`emptyIsAbsent: false`). **Right**, and consistent with the door.
- **The widening half (brief d): a comma list becomes `ApprovalStatus[]`.** `buildRequestWhere` (plugin approval-service.ts L9152-9160) pushes an array down as `status: { $in: [...] }`, equality for one, and the engine `find` is the only consumer of that `where`; the same `$in` on this column is already production code in the strandable sweep (L7299) and the service comment states every bundled driver supports it. `countRequests` builds its `where` through the same function, so `total` counts the same set. No caller's literal status can contain a comma: the set is closed and comma-free. On this door `approverId` already splits on commas, so the spelling is the door's own convention, not a new one. **Right.** Trimming `' pending '` (previously forwarded raw and matching nothing) is an incidental widening with no loser.
- **Envelope (brief b).** The new refusal writes `res.status(400).json({ error: { code: 'VALIDATION_ERROR', message } })`; `refuseUnknownQueryParams` (query-allowlist.ts L221-227) and `refuseRepeatedQueryParams` (query-multiplicity.ts L165-168) write the identical shape. The message names each bad value once and `Allowed values: pending, approved, rejected, recalled, returned, cancelled.` **Right.** (The `limit`/`offset` refusal on the same door goes through `handleRouteError`, a pre-existing second shape; not moved by this PR.)
- **Gate order.** Name, arity, then the `limit`/`offset` read, then the status value. The PR body's "name, then arity, then value" omits the whole-number read that sits between; the code comment says only "after the name and arity gates", which is accurate. No contract effect.
- **Public surface.** No export moves: `readApprovalStatusFilter` is module-private, `APPROVAL_REQUEST_LIST_PARAMS` is unchanged (`status` was already in the closed name set, rest-server.ts L602-611), no `packages/spec` change, no metadata author surface. `Metadata-protocol: none` is **right**.
- **Test change in `rest-server-approvals-unknown-filter.test.ts`.** The every-name case sent `'1'` to every parameter; `status=1` is now refused by design, so sending `pending` for `status` keeps the pin's meaning (names accepted) without weakening it. **Right.**

### ② Semver level

- `@objectstack/rest` **`patch`**, title `fix(rest)!:`, `**BREAKING**` banner, `Clause-②: yes (narrowing)` and `Metadata-protocol: none` line-initial in both the PR body and the changeset. Per the Post-Task Checklist #3 the level follows the kind alone: `none` takes `patch`, and a non-protocol breaking change ships `patch` keeping its BREAKING banner and ADR-0087 disposition. **Matches what the diff publishes.**
- `Clause-②:` arm: the diff refuses values it accepted, so `(narrowing)` is the arm; the comma-list widening rides beside it and is named in the same line. **Right.**
- ADR-0087 marker: exactly one, `not-required (no-migration-prescription)`, a category of the closed vocabulary (ADR-0087 L750). The body carries a one-line remedy ("send one of ..., or leave `status` out") and no FROM/TO arrow or framed table; nothing at rest records a query-string value, so no `migrate meta` rewrite exists. `Check Changeset` and `Lint · PM dispatch-gates` are green on the head. **Right.**
- The changeset's "and its environment-scoped twin" is read in the code: same handler registration under both base paths. **Right.**

### ③ Boundary flags

- `open_questions`: none declared. Nothing to escalate.
- Deviation 1 (allowed set read from `APPROVAL_STATUSES`, not a per-request metadata read): **accepted**: it is the same single source the object reads, pinned by test; a metadata read per inbox poll would add a failure arm with no gain in truth.
- Deviation 2 (comma list reaches the service as an array): **accepted**: `@objectstack/client` `approvals.listRequests({ status: [...] })` is typed `ApprovalStatus | ApprovalStatus[]` and comma-joins (client index.ts L6508-6512), a capability declared on `main` and not delivered at the door. Implementing it is the right disposition; refusing it at the consumer would have been the thing this brief forbids.
- Deviation 3 (full workspace build outside `os-verify-lock`) and 5 (no reviewer/assignee written): process, no bearing on the contract; the head's check-runs are the gate verdicts here.
- Deviation 4 (`main` moved 18 commits, not re-merged): judged on the tree. `git log f273c9fe..origin/main` over every cited file is empty, so the review's reading of `main` and the PR's merge-base agree; the check-runs on the head stand.
- Out-of-scope finding (console status picker lacks `cancelled`): correctly left to the ui lane, no `ui/**` in this diff; the picker sends only declared values and `all` sends no `status`, so the console loses nothing.

### ④ Design judgment

The narrowing against the published spec on `main`: the contract type, the object's select and the SDK's parameter type all declare the six-value set; the door was the one consumer that let a seventh value through and answered the same empty list the declared values answer when nothing is in them. The PR makes the spec's own refusal real at the HTTP consumer and takes no declared capability away. The one declared-but-undelivered capability it met (the SDK's array form) it implemented rather than narrowed.

Attempts to break it, read against the code: `?status=` and `?status=,` refuse (empty is unknown); `Pending` refuses (the object's values are lower case, exact match is the contract); `%2C` decodes to the same comma split; `pending,pending` reaches the service as the string `pending`; a nested query object refuses before the service; `?status=bogus&limit=abc` refuses on `limit` first (pre-existing order), `?status=bogus&status=pending` on arity; a deployment with no approvals plugin still answers `{"data":[]}` before any gate, the name gate included (pre-existing, not moved). Readers of the door on `main`: the console inbox and bell feed send `pending` or a picker value and omit `status` for `all`; `approvalRequestsDataSource` scopes send `status=pending`; `data-objectstack` and `useRecordApprovals` send no `status`; every dogfood test sends `status=pending`; no MCP tool or CLI command calls the list route (brief e). Sibling repositories (`cloud`, `hotcrm`) are not readable from here; the SDK's parameter type confines a typed caller to the set.

- **should-fix** — `readApprovalStatusFilter`, non-string arm: `[String(raw)]` puts `"[object Object]"` into the refusal sentence for a nested query object (`?status[$ne]=pending`), so the located message names a value the caller never typed. Say the parameter must be a string instead. Cosmetic; the status, envelope and no-service-call are right and tested.
- **should-fix** (docs lane, not this PR, no card filed here) — `content/docs/automation/approvals.mdx` L740 lists five statuses without `cancelled`. Pre-existing; every value it lists is accepted, so no reader loses anything, but now that the door refuses undeclared values the published list should match the six the route names.

No must-fix.

## 维护者速读

1. 改了什么：审批收件箱列表 `GET /api/v1/approvals/requests` 现在核对 `status`，必须是审批请求真实存在的六种状态之一（pending、approved、rejected、recalled、returned、cancelled），拼错或空值答 400 并列出允许值；逗号列表（`pending,returned`）按多个状态一起查。
2. 为什么改：以前拼错状态（`Pending`、`waiting`）得到空列表，提醒脚本会静默漏掉待审；SDK 传数组时发逗号列表，以前被当成一个值永远查不到。
3. 风险：收窄（BREAKING）。发错状态值或空 `status=` 的脚本开始收到 400；控制台、铃铛和 SDK 只发合法值，不受影响。回滚即 revert。
4. 先看：`packages/rest/src/approvals-routes.ts` 的 `readApprovalStatusFilter` 和列表路由调用它的几行。
5. 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest exec vitest run rest-server-approvals-status-value` ，16 条全绿。
6. 需要你做的：无，席位落地。合约审查 PASS 6659996154 在案，两条 should-fix 已立卡 #30525；按 maintainer 13:47Z「技能不需要我审核的不应该等我」，不属 Tier H、不超 3000 行。

席位意见：ACCEPT（#29880）。审批收件箱按状态筛选时，写错的状态值现在会被明确拒绝并告知可用的六个值，不再静默返回空列表；按多个状态一起筛选（SDK 的数组写法）现在真正生效。发空 `status=` 的调用会开始被拒（收窄）。
